stages.condition: Ensure-exists the per-intent record and artifact dirs — idempotent (creates on demand, skips existing)
stages.inputs_text: none (first stage after session start)
stages.outputs_text: the per-intent record tree (stage artifact dirs + verification dir) and the space-level knowledge/ dir

stages.condition: Scans and classifies workspace — auto-proceeds (no approval gate)
stages.inputs_text: none (scans filesystem)
stages.outputs_text: workspace classification (greenfield/brownfield), technology stack detection

stages.condition: Creates full populated state file and determines routing — auto-proceeds
stages.inputs_text: workspace classification from workspace-detection, scope from orchestrator
stages.outputs_text: <record>/aidlc-state.md (full populated version, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: First stage of every workflow — establishes the initiative's foundation
stages.inputs_text: User's project description ($ARGUMENTS), scope selection
stages.outputs_text: intent-statement.md, stakeholder-map.md, intent-capture-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when initiative has external market positioning or build-vs-buy considerations. Skip for internal tools, bug fixes, or refactors.
stages.inputs_text: Intent statement from intent-capture stage
stages.outputs_text: competitive-analysis.md, market-trends.md, build-vs-buy.md, market-research-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when there are integration constraints, regulatory requirements, or significant technical uncertainty. Skip for trivial changes with no technical risk.
stages.inputs_text: Intent statement from intent-capture stage, market research from market-research stage (if executed)
stages.outputs_text: feasibility-assessment.md, constraint-register.md, raid-log.md, feasibility-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Always executes — defines the scope boundary and prioritized backlog
stages.inputs_text: Intent statement, feasibility assessment, constraint register
stages.outputs_text: scope-document.md, intent-backlog.md, scope-definition-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when team composition, capacity, or mob planning is relevant. Skip for solo developer or small team projects.
stages.inputs_text: Scope definition, intent backlog, feasibility assessment
stages.outputs_text: team-assessment.md, skill-matrix.md, mob-composition.md, team-formation-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when user-facing UI is part of the initiative; for API/backend, produce system interaction diagrams. Skip for non-UI, API-only, or infrastructure-only initiatives.
stages.inputs_text: Intent statement, scope definition, intent backlog
stages.outputs_text: wireframes.md, user-flow.md, rough-mockups-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Always executes — compiles all Ideation artifacts into initiative brief for approval
stages.inputs_text: All Ideation phase artifacts (intent, market research, feasibility, scope, team, mockups)
stages.outputs_text: initiative-brief.md, decision-log.md, approval-handoff-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when project is brownfield. Always rerun for freshness. Skip for greenfield projects.
stages.inputs_text: <record>/aidlc-state.md
stages.outputs_text: aidlc/spaces/<active-space>/codekb/<repo>/ (9 artifacts: business-overview.md, architecture.md, code-structure.md, api-documentation.md, component-inventory.md, technology-stack.md, dependencies.md, code-quality-assessment.md, reverse-engineering-timestamp.md)

stages.condition: Always rerun for freshness. Brownfield discovers from evidence + reverse-engineering artifacts. Greenfield prompts user via structured questions using org.md defaults.
stages.inputs_text: <record>/aidlc-state.md + (brownfield) reverse-engineering's 8 artifacts
stages.outputs_text: team-practices.md, discovered-rules.md, evidence.md, practices-discovery-timestamp.md (4 artifacts under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved). On affirmation, content is promoted to the harness rule layer's aidlc-team.md and aidlc-project.md.

stages.condition: Always executes — depth scales with project complexity
stages.inputs_text: RE artifacts (if brownfield), user's project description (from <record>/audit/<host>-<clone>.md)
stages.outputs_text: requirements.md, requirements-analysis-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when user-facing features, multiple personas, complex business logic, or cross-team work is involved. Skip for pure refactoring, isolated bug fixes, infrastructure-only changes, or developer tooling.
stages.inputs_text: <record>/inception/requirements-analysis/requirements.md, RE artifacts (if brownfield)
stages.outputs_text: stories.md, personas.md, user-stories-assessment.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when user-facing UI exists and rough mockups were produced in Ideation; for APIs, refine interaction diagrams
stages.inputs_text: Rough mockups from rough-mockups stage, user stories from user-stories stage, requirements from requirements-analysis stage
stages.outputs_text: mockups.md, interaction-spec.md, design-system-mapping.md, accessibility-checklist.md, refined-mockups-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when new components or services are needed, or service layer design is required. Skip when changes are modifications to existing components only.
stages.inputs_text: <record>/inception/requirements-analysis/requirements.md, <record>/inception/user-stories/stories.md (if produced), RE artifacts (if brownfield)
stages.outputs_text: components.md, component-methods.md, services.md, component-dependency.md, decisions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Always executes when in scope. Produces the dependency DAG that Stage 2.8 Delivery Planning consumes for Bolt sequencing. In the compiled scope grid, 2.7 and 2.8 travel together — both EXECUTE or both SKIP per scope.
stages.inputs_text: <record>/inception/application-design/ (all design artifacts), <record>/inception/requirements-analysis/requirements.md, <record>/inception/user-stories/stories.md (if produced)
stages.outputs_text: unit-of-work.md, unit-of-work-dependency.md, unit-of-work-story-map.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Always executes — capstone Inception stage, produces the detailed execution plan for Construction and Operation
stages.inputs_text: All Inception artifacts (requirements, stories, mockups, architecture, units)
stages.outputs_text: bolt-plan.md, team-allocation.md, risk-and-sequencing-rationale.md, external-dependency-map.md, delivery-planning-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: New data models, complex business logic, or business rules need design. Skip if simple logic changes with no new business logic.
stages.inputs_text: unit-of-work.md, unit-of-work-story-map.md, requirements.md, application design artifacts
stages.outputs_text: business-logic-model.md, business-rules.md, domain-entities.md, CONDITIONAL: frontend-components.md (under this stage's per-unit record dir, engine-resolved); per-kind applicability via produces_kinds (untagged unit: all)

stages.condition: Performance requirements, security considerations, scalability concerns, or tech stack selection needed. Skip if no NFR requirements and tech stack already determined.
stages.inputs_text: functional design artifacts, requirements.md, RE artifacts
stages.outputs_text: performance-requirements.md, security-requirements.md, scalability-requirements.md, reliability-requirements.md, tech-stack-decisions.md (under this stage's per-unit record dir, engine-resolved); per-kind applicability via produces_kinds (untagged unit: all)

stages.condition: NFR Requirements was executed and NFR patterns need design. Skip if NFR Requirements was skipped.
stages.inputs_text: NFR requirements artifacts, functional design artifacts
stages.outputs_text: performance-design.md, security-design.md, scalability-design.md, reliability-design.md, logical-components.md (under this stage's per-unit record dir, engine-resolved); per-kind applicability via produces_kinds (untagged unit: all)

stages.condition: Infrastructure services need mapping, deployment architecture required, or cloud resources needed. Skip if no infrastructure changes and infrastructure already defined.
stages.inputs_text: NFR design artifacts, application design, functional design
stages.outputs_text: deployment-architecture.md, infrastructure-services.md, monitoring-design.md, cicd-pipeline.md, CONDITIONAL: shared-infrastructure.md (under this stage's per-unit record dir, engine-resolved); per-kind applicability via produces_kinds (untagged unit: all)

stages.condition: Always executes for every unit in the execution plan.
stages.inputs_text: ALL prior design artifacts for this unit
stages.outputs_text: application code + code-generation-plan.md, code-summary.md (under this stage's per-unit record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Always executes once after all per-unit stages are finished.
stages.inputs_text: ALL code generation outputs across all units
stages.outputs_text: build-instructions.md, unit-test-instructions.md, integration-test-instructions.md, performance-test-instructions.md, security-test-instructions.md, build-and-test-summary.md, test-results.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when CI pipeline needs creation or significant modification. Skip if CI already exists and is adequate.
stages.inputs_text: Code generation output from code-generation stage, build/test results from build-and-test stage
stages.outputs_text: ci-config.md, quality-gates.md, ci-pipeline-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when CD pipeline needs creation or significant modification
stages.inputs_text: CI pipeline config from ci-pipeline stage, infrastructure design from infrastructure-design stage
stages.outputs_text: cd-config.md, deployment-strategy.md, rollback-runbook.md, deployment-pipeline-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when AWS environments need provisioning or validation
stages.inputs_text: Infrastructure design from infrastructure-design stage, CD pipeline config from deployment-pipeline stage
stages.outputs_text: environment-inventory.md, validation-report.md, environment-provisioning-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute after deployment pipeline and environment are ready
stages.inputs_text: CD pipeline config from deployment-pipeline stage, provisioned environments from environment-provisioning stage, built artifacts from Construction
stages.outputs_text: deployment-log.md, smoke-test-results.md, health-check-report.md, deployment-execution-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when monitoring, dashboards, alarms, or tracing need configuration
stages.inputs_text: NFR design from nfr-design stage, infrastructure design from infrastructure-design stage, deployed application
stages.outputs_text: dashboards.md, alarms.md, slo-config.md, log-queries.md, tracing-config.md, anomaly-config.md, observability-setup-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when operational runbooks and incident response procedures are needed
stages.inputs_text: Observability setup from observability-setup stage, NFR design from nfr-design stage, infrastructure design from infrastructure-design stage
stages.outputs_text: runbooks.md, incident-plan.md, escalation-matrix.md, incident-response-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when NFR performance targets need validation under load
stages.inputs_text: NFR requirements from nfr-requirements stage, NFR design from nfr-design stage, deployed application, observability data from observability-setup stage
stages.outputs_text: load-test-plan.md, test-results.md, nfr-validation-matrix.md, performance-validation-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)

stages.condition: Execute when ongoing operational monitoring and optimization are needed
stages.inputs_text: All Operation phase artifacts, production monitoring data
stages.outputs_text: slo-report.md, cost-analysis.md, drift-report.md, feedback-loop.md, feedback-optimization-questions.md (under this stage's record dir, engine-resolved)
